Pretty Amazing Overall. There were some pictures that it seemed to take the color out of, but that was rare and I spent an hour or two last night trying it out on a hundred pictures. I have a lot of old family pictures, and even sometimes an older iPhone picture and I was amazed. There weren’t very many that I chose to keep the ‘before’. Most of the ‘after’s were really impressive. I had an old picture from a wedding 50 years ago. You could barely tell who was in the picture. It was very washed out and the figures were blurry. I applied the enhancers and then a color enhancer and it looked like we had taken the picture recently instead of 50 years ago. And now you can tell who is in the picture. Highly recommend, and I’m going to pay for the year’s subscription. They will give you a week free, to decide whether you want to pay to keep the app or not.
